disease_check.summary: The list captures most major tomato diseases accurately but contains several duplicates (Fusarium Wilt/Wilts, Leaf Mold/Tomato Leaf Mould, Bacterial Wilt/Southern Bacterial Wilt) and vague or non-standard labels (Bacterial Leaf Spot, Brown Spot, Leaf Mosaic Virus, Leaf Yellow Virus, Phytoplasma). disease_check.summary: The list captures most major wheat diseases but contains substantial redundancy, with multiple labels referring to the same disease (rusts, bunts, Septoria/Zymoseptoria, black chaff, Cephalosporium stripe, BYDV). Several entries are pathogen names rather than disease names (Blumeria graminis f., Parastagonospora nodorum, Zymoseptoria tritici, Fusarium graminearum Schwabe), and a few are incorrect for wheat (Fusarium Wilts, Phytophthora Root and Crown Rots, Bacterial Brown Spot of Bean/Canker of Stone Fruit, Resistance Phenotype). Cleanup should deduplicate umbrella/specific pairs, standardize to disease names, and remove non-wheat or non-disease entries.
